about: The peaks a saved measurement's report shows are the peaks it shows on screen: a guitar's at or above its Peak Min, a plate's or brace's identified peaks whatever the Peak Min. Each case: a fixture, the Peak Min it is read with (null: as saved), how many of its peaks are at or above that Peak Min (peaksAbovePeakMin), how many of those are in the saved range — the header's "Detected Peaks: N", none for a plate or brace (detectedPeaksInView) — and the report's Selected Peaks rows: the selected peaks among them in the saved range, by frequency rounded to 0.1 Hz. Expected values are Swift's.

cases.note: as saved (Peak Min -78 dB): every peak is at or above it; the selected Air, Top and Back are listed
Peak Min -60 dB hides the selected Air (97.3 Hz, -64.2 dB): the report leaves it out, as the screen does
Peak Min -50 dB leaves only Top
a plate's identified peaks (one at -59.0 dB) are its peaks whatever the Peak Min
